mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fcm_batch_schedule_backup ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, session_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, orig_seq BIGINT NOT NULL, account_seq BIGINT, schedule_seq BIGINT, start_date VARCHAR(20), end_date VARCHAR(20), time VARCHAR(20), is_done BOOLEAN, is_enabled BOOLEAN, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fcm_test_mode ( session_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, backed_up_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, prepared_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fcm_batch_schedule_backup ( session_id, orig_seq, account_seq, schedule_seq, start_date, end_date, time, is_done, is_enabled ) SELECT #{sessionId}, seq, account_seq, schedule_seq, start_date, end_date, time, is_done, is_enabled FROM account_batch_schedule WHERE is_enabled = true
mapper.update: UPDATE account_batch_schedule SET is_enabled = false WHERE is_enabled = true
UPDATE account_batch_schedule abs SET is_enabled = b.is_enabled FROM fcm_batch_schedule_backup b WHERE abs.seq = b.orig_seq AND b.session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fcm_test_mode (session_id, backed_up_count, prepared_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{backedUpCount}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT session_id AS sessionId, backed_up_count AS backedUpCount, to_char(prepared_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS preparedAt FROM fcm_test_mode LIMIT 1
